content.comment_body: How long does it take for a [product_name] RC model to lose its internal clock data after being powered off?
Dear customer, The internal clock is buffered for approximately 80 hours at 25°C. This information is detailed in Appendix A of the [document]. [url] Your Technical Support

analysis.insight_summary: Users requested information about how long the internal clock in [product_name] RC models retains its time when powered off. Technical support responded that the clock is maintained for around 80 hours at a temperature of 25°C and referred users to official documentation. The exchange demonstrates the importance of dependable real-time clock specifications and easy access to relevant information.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward and detailed guidance on how long the real-time clock will preserve its data when a [product_name] device is not powered.
